sources.storage: SQLite events table selected by --db / FISHWORLD_DB
sources.read_scope: Only the explicitly selected FishWorld database; no unrelated files or browser profiles
sources.observed_at: UTC time when this adapter observes the event
sources.summary_authority: Model-generated summaries are separate evidence, not replacements for raw events
sources.reflection_authority: Voluntary player text; never authored by the world model
sources.versioning: Existing local-study-export Ledger.scan by stable ID and canonical content; retain version/deletion observations
sources.chunking: Approximately 1 MB per file, complete record boundaries, oversized individual record stays complete
sources.privacy: Exclude API player Core, memory summary, keys and hidden mystery truth; existing Ledger quarantines suspected sensitive text

unified_exporter.implementation: Reuse the existing local-study-export/export_local.py Ledger; path explicitly supplied by the operator

sources.github_publication: Not performed by export; personal data requires separate explicit authorization
